description: This bar chart, from the paper "EssayBench Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese Essay Writing," illustrates the sample count distribution across four essay genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—by comparing two categories: "Open" (light blue bars) and "Cons." (pink bars), as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis lists the four genres in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis, labeled "Sample Count," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each genre has two adjacent bars: for Argumentative, the Open bar is 79 and the Cons. bar is 122; for Narrative, the Open bar is 80 and the Cons. bar is 87; for Descriptive, the Open bar is 68 and the Cons. bar is 101 (with a small gray bar on top of the Cons. bar, labeled 101, which appears to be a separate data point or error bar); and for Expository, the Open bar is 62 and the Cons. bar is 130. The bars are not sorted, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar.
